knownWallets.label: Ondo Foundation Group - Multisig 2
knownWallets.note: Disclosed by the Ondo Foundation Group (4,422,519,707 locked ONDO, updated 2026-08-26). Safe 4-of-7.

knownWallets.label: Ondo distribution Safe A (funded by Multisig 2)
knownWallets.note: Owner-confirmed developer-held (2026-11-03). Safe 3-of-6; funded only by Multisig 2 (~1.55B ONDO, e.g. tx 0xa4aff968... is its 29.3M to Safe D2e6). Multisig 2 <-> this Safe = internal_shuffle; only flows leaving the dev set count. Signers do not overlap Multisig 2 signers.

knownWallets.label: Ondo distribution Safe B (funded by Multisig 2)
knownWallets.note: Owner-confirmed developer-held (2026-11-03). Safe 3-of-6; funded only by Multisig 2 (725M, Apr-Sep 2026); Arkham/press 'team-linked wallet' feeding Coinbase. Multisig 2 <-> this Safe = internal_shuffle. Signers do not overlap Multisig 2 signers.

knownWallets.label: Ondo distribution Safe C (funded by Multisig 2)
knownWallets.note: Safe 4-of-7. ONDO inflows only from Ondo wallets: 101M from Multisig 2 (tx 0x514af793..., 2023-01-30), 29.3M from Safe A (tx 0xa4aff968...), 9.8M from Safe 0x1189...9452 (tx 0x4c5adfa6...). Sent 12-ONDO test transfers to the seven tranche recipients (tx 0x09f85464...) a month before Multisig 2 paid them.

knownWallets.label: Ondo Safe 0x1189 (shares signers with Ondo Management/legacy multisigs)
